message.content: On September 20th, 2026, Thane Chambers asked Li Hua about her favorite first-person shooter game. Specifically, he inquired, "What’s your favorite first-person shooter game? I'm curious! 🎮" Li Hua responded enthusiastically by saying she's really into "Call of Duty: Warzone" lately, particularly enjoying the battle royale mode. She explained that the strategic element and adrenaline rush of the game are her favorite aspects.
